nav.label: Sections
health.label: API
welcome.headline:
One sheet a day.
One version that rules.
welcome.subcopy: Every cut-off date is a snapshot of the portfolio. When the lender sends a corrected file, the new version is stored whole alongside the previous one and you choose which one counts. Nothing is overwritten and nothing changes until you confirm it.
welcome.badge.todasVigentes: {n} cut-off dates, all with a current version
welcome.diagram.title: How a sheet travels
console.ruler.title: Cut-off dates
console.ruler.empty: No sheet has been uploaded yet.
console.firstRun.title: No sheet has been uploaded yet.
console.firstRun.body: Upload the day's sheet and choose its cut-off date. Every file is kept as a version of that date: it is validated, normalised, and every issue it carries is reported back to you.
console.offline.title: No connection to the API
console.offline.body: The backend could not be reached, so nothing can be listed or uploaded. Check that it is running and try again.
console.upload.title: Upload a sheet
console.upload.intro: Every file you upload creates a new version of its cut-off date. An existing version is never overwritten.
console.upload.file.hint: Excel (.xlsx, .xlsb, .xls, .ods), CSV or JSON, up to 64 MB.
console.upload.error.tooBig: The file is over the 64 MB maximum.
console.upload.error.date: State the cut-off date this sheet represents.
console.upload.error.network: Could not reach the API. Check that the backend is running.
console.duplicate.title: This file was uploaded before
console.duplicate.body: The file is identical to version {versiones} of the same date. The new version was registered anyway and is being processed.
console.progress.title: Processing version {version}
console.progress.hint: This takes a few seconds. Carry on working; we'll tell you when it ends.
console.day.title: Versions of {fecha}
console.day.empty.title: This day has no versions.
console.day.empty.body: Upload this date's sheet to get started.
console.day.noVigente: This date has no current version. Nothing calculated over the portfolio takes it into account.
console.summary.title: Version summary
console.summary.pending: The summary appears once processing ends.
console.incidencias.title: Issues
console.incidencias.empty: This version has no issues of that severity.
console.incidencias.emptyAll: This version was processed without a single issue.
console.vigente.title: Which version counts for {fecha}?
console.vigente.intro: Version {nueva} finished processing and this date already had a current version. Choose which one counts from here on.
console.vigente.keepNote: Nothing changes. This is the preselected option.
console.vigente.replaceNote: Portfolio, history and metrics are recalculated over this version.
console.vigente.formatChanged: This version's format differs from the current one.
console.setVigente.title: Change the current version
console.setVigente.body: Version {version} becomes the current version of {fecha}. Everything calculated over the portfolio — history, presence and metrics — will be read from it.
console.setVigente.error409: Only a finished version can be the current one.
console.delete.title: Delete version {version}
console.delete.body: Its rows, its issues and the original file are erased. An audit record with no sheet data remains. This cannot be undone.
console.delete.vigenteWarning: This is the current version of {fecha}.
console.delete.vigenteChoice: I confirm that {fecha} is left with no current version
console.delete.vigenteChoiceNote: While the date has no current version, that day counts for neither the portfolio nor the metrics.
console.delete.vigenteAlternative: You can also make another version of this date current before deleting.
console.delete.needsConfirm: Tick the box to confirm the date is left with no current version.
console.mapeo.reanalizar.aviso: Changing {opcion} reads the file again and discards what you chose in the columns.
console.mapeo.motivo.obligatorio: The required field {campo} still needs a column.
console.mapeo.motivo.revisarUna: Review 1 column to be able to load.
console.mapeo.motivo.revisar: Review {n} columns to be able to load.
console.mapeo.motivo.corregir: Fix the marked columns to be able to load.
console.mapeo.motivo.sinValidar: The columns could not be checked. Try again.
common.errorBody: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
incidencia.cabecera_desconocida: Unrecognised header; the column was not catalogued
incidencia.cabecera_duplicada: The header appears more than once
incidencia.columna_faltante: Expected column missing from the file
incidencia.columnas_opcionales_ausentes: The file does not have these optional columns: those fields are empty in this version
incidencia.valor_no_escalar: The value was an object or a list; it was saved as JSON text
incidencia.valor_no_convertible: The value does not match the type of the additional field; it was left empty
incidencia.clave_no_texto: The promissory-note key is not valid text
incidencia.pagare_repetido: Key repeated in the file; the first occurrence was kept
incidencia.pagare_duplicado_distinto: The key repeats with different data
incidencia.documento_formato_invalido: The document is neither an integer nor text
incidencia.documento_solo_ceros: Document made up of zeros only
incidencia.ruc_invalido: 11-digit RUC with an invalid prefix or check digit
incidencia.dni_completado_con_ceros: DNI padded to 8 digits with leading zeros
incidencia.fecha_invalida: Could not be read as a date
incidencia.vencimiento_operativo_vacio: Expected NO or a date; arrived empty
incidencia.cuotas_inconsistentes: Paid plus pending do not add up to approved
incidencia.dias_atraso_difiere_entidad: Days overdue differ from the lender's figure
selector.title: Selection
selector.problemas.titulo: These parts do not apply to the current catalogue, and the selection is not computed until they are fixed or removed:
selector.filtros.vacio: No filters: the whole day's portfolio counts.
selector.cantidad.hint: The first n by the order. Empty: everything that meets the filters.
selector.cantidad.error: Enter a whole number between 1 and 120,000.
selector.indicadores.vacio: Beyond accounts, capital and instalments, you can compute your own.
selector.guardarComo.intro: It is shared with the team and works for any cut-off date.
selector.guardar.vacio: Enter a name for the selection.
selector.guardar.repetido: A selection with that name already exists. Choose another.
selector.guardar.noExiste: This selection no longer exists: someone deleted it. You can save it as new.
selector.borrar.cuerpo: It is deleted for the whole team. What is on screen stays as a new, unsaved selection.
selector.descartar.cuerpo: If you load another selection, the current changes are lost.
cartera.title: Portfolio selection
cartera.intro: Filter the day's current portfolio, choose how many products go to work and compare what you take with everything that meets the filters.
cartera.flujo.sinTope: no count: the whole universe goes
cartera.insuficiente: You asked for the first {solicitados}, but only {disponibles} products meet the filters. The selection carries those {disponibles}.
cartera.segmentos.vacio: Choose a field to see accounts and capital for each value.
cartera.aviso.sinFechas.titulo: There is no portfolio to select from yet.
cartera.aviso.sinFechas.cuerpo: A day's portfolio comes from its current sheet. Upload today's in the upload console and come back.
cartera.aviso.sinVigente.cuerpo: That date has no current version, so there are no products to read. This is not an empty selection: its sheet needs to be chosen or uploaded.
cartera.aviso.noAplica.titulo: The selection has parts that do not apply.
cartera.aviso.noAplica.cuerpo: They are marked in the editor. Fix or remove them and the metrics recalculate on their own.
cartera.aviso.consulta.titulo: The API did not accept the query.
cartera.aviso.consulta.cuerpo: Check the marked filters and indicators.
mowaMes.config.title: MOWA MES settings
mowaMes.config.intro: What every campaign starts from. Each block saves on its own.
mowaMes.plataforma.title: Platform
mowaMes.plataforma.limite.hint: {n} SMS per calendar month, counting products and supervision.
mowaMes.plataforma.limite.rango: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
mowaMes.plataforma.whatsapp.hint: A 9-digit number. The speech turns it into https://wa.me/+51 followed by the number.
mowaMes.plataforma.whatsapp.invalido: The WhatsApp number is not valid.
mowaMes.plataforma.sinWhatsapp: Without a contact WhatsApp, the speech segments that use it cannot be generated.
mowaMes.supervisores.title: Default supervisors
mowaMes.supervisores.vacio: No supervisors are configured. Without supervisors no campaign can be created.
mowaMes.supervisores.procedencias.hint: Documents are numbered from 00000001: first those of the first origin, then those of the next.
mowaMes.supervisores.ninguno: There are no supervisors in the list yet.
mowaMes.supervisores.documentosPendiente: There are unsaved changes: documents are reassigned on save.
mowaMes.supervisores.problema.procedenci: Origin {n} repeats a name already in the list.
Supervisor {n} has an origin that is no longer in the list.
mowaMes.speech.title: Speech by segment
mowaMes.speech.inmutable.usada: A campaign already used this version, so it is not modified. Your changes are saved as a new version based on it.
mowaMes.speech.inmutable.v1: Two-part version (v1): it is used in campaigns as it is and is no longer edited.
mowaMes.speech.faltaWhatsapp: The contact WhatsApp is missing and some segments use [whatsapp]: they cannot be generated until it is set under Platform.
mowaMes.speech.problemas: The API does not accept these parts:
mowaMes.speech.estructura: Message = holder (8 characters) + part 1 + instalment due date (dd/mm/yyyy) + part 2. Where it says [whatsapp], the link to the contact WhatsApp goes.
mowaMes.speech.sinEjemplo: No example: the contact WhatsApp is missing.
mowaMes.speech.gsm7: When generating, accents are removed, signs the SMS does not accept are replaced by a simple one, and those with no equivalent are deleted. The version is saved as you write it.
mowaMes.speech.calculoUnidad: Counted the way the SMS counts it: replaced signs are counted already replaced (“…” takes 3, as “...”, and so does “€”, as “EUR”).
mowaMes.speech.calculo: Length computed with an 8-character holder, a 10-character date and the WhatsApp link. A warning from {advertencia}, excluded from {maximo}.
mowaMes.speech.nombre.automatico: Empty: it will be named Speech N
mowaMes.speech.cambiosPendientes: This version has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before switching versions.
mowaMes.speech.error.nombreRepetido: A version with that name already exists. Choose another.
mowaMes.speech.error.usada: This version can no longer be modified. Save your changes as a new version.
mowaMes.calendario.title: Working-day calendar
mowaMes.calendario.intro: Working days run Monday to Friday, without holidays. Statutory holidays are computed automatically; here you record decreed non-working days and holidays that do not apply in a given year.
mowaMes.calendario.vacio: This year has no non-working days recorded.
mowaMes.calendario.accion.retirar.aria: Withdraw the holiday on {fecha} this year
mowaMes.calendario.dialogo.agregarIntro: A day decreed non-working stops being a working day, like a holiday.
mowaMes.calendario.dialogo.retirarIntro: That day becomes a working day again for this year only. The holiday stays in the law and you can restore it.
mowaMes.calendario.error.repetida: That date already has an exception recorded.
mowaMes.codigo.telefono_invalido: No valid phone: missing, or not 9 digits starting with 9.
mowaMes.codigo.sin_speech: No speech: its adjusted days past due exceed 120, or it has no days past due.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_titular: The holder is missing, and the message needs it.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_vencimiento: The instalment due date is missing, and the message needs it.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_campo_adicional: An additional field that the message needs is missing.
mowaMes.codigo.mensaje_excede_160: The message is longer than 160 characters: it does not fit in one SMS and is excluded.
mowaMes.codigo.mensaje_excede_150: The message is longer than 150 characters: it is loaded, but the speech should be shortened.
mowaMes.codigo.limite_mensual_excedido: The campaign would exceed the monthly SMS limit: creating it requires confirmation.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.ok: Every segment fits in one SMS.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.falta_whatsapp.un: 1 segment cannot be generated without WhatsApp.
mowaMes.speech.resumen.falta_whatsapp: {n} segments cannot be generated without WhatsApp.
mowaMes.codigo.id_sin_correspondencia: A MES id in the report matches no loaded row of this campaign: it probably belongs to another one.
mowaMes.codigo.falta_whatsapp: A segment with products uses [whatsapp] and there is no contact WhatsApp number.
mowaMes.codigo.sin_supervisores: The campaign has no supervisors: it cannot be created without them.
mowaMes.codigo.sin_productos_cargables: No product made it into the load: there is nothing to send.
mowaMes.codigo.version_v1_retirada: Two-part versions (v1) can no longer be created or edited. To customize this version, convert it to v2.
mowaMes.codigo.documento_no_estandar: The document is neither a DNI nor a RUC: it is loaded anyway, but it is worth checking.
mowaMes.plataforma.registros.hint: Up to {max} rows per file; supervision counts within the first one.
mowaMes.plataforma.registros.rango: Rows per file range from {min} to {max}.
mowaMes.plataforma.bytes.rango: Size per file ranges from {min} to {max} bytes.

mowaMes.seguimiento.intro: Generated campaigns, their files, the sent report MES returns and the monthly limit's consumption.
mowaMes.seguimiento.limite.title: Monthly limit
mowaMes.seguimiento.limite.excedido: The month exceeded the limit: {cargados} loaded out of {limite}.
mowaMes.seguimiento.limite.nota: Each campaign counts in the month of its send date, products and supervision included.

mowaMes.seguimiento.campanas.vacio: No campaign has been generated yet.
mowaMes.seguimiento.detalle.title: Campaign {id}
mowaMes.seguimiento.detalle.vacio: Choose a campaign to see its detail.
mowaMes.seguimiento.archivos.title: Load files
mowaMes.seguimiento.archivos.descargado: File {archivo} of {total} downloaded: {filas} rows, {supervision} of supervision.
mowaMes.seguimiento.reporte.title: Sent report
mowaMes.seguimiento.reporte.intro: Upload the report you download from MES for this campaign. Every MES id in the file is linked to it.
mowaMes.seguimiento.reporte.hint: The .xlsx you download from MES, up to 32 MB.
mowaMes.seguimiento.reporte.error.grande: The file is over the 32 MB maximum.

mowaMes.seguimiento.reemplazar.body: If you replace it, the rows of that MES id are swapped for the new file's and the reconciliation is recalculated.

mowaMes.seguimiento.conciliacion.vacio: No sent report has been imported for this campaign yet.
mowaMes.seguimiento.conciliacion.nota: Sent counts only the rows whose status in the report is “enviado”. A loaded row with any other status, or missing from the report, counts as not sent.
mowaMes.seguimiento.conciliacion.sinCorr: Report rows with no match in the campaign: {n}
mowaMes.seguimiento.conciliacion.idsNota: It tells whether the id belongs to this campaign, not how much was sent.

mowaMes.exclusiones.faltaCampoAdicional: The additional field {campos} is missing, and the message needs it.
mowaMes.exclusiones.faltanCamposAdiciona: The additional fields {campos} are missing, and the message needs them.
mowaMes.campana.avisoArchivado: The speech uses the archived field {campos}. Sheets loaded after it was archived no longer bring it, and the products that need it are left out. To avoid this, reactivate it in Uploads › Additional fields or remove it from the speech.
mowaMes.campana.avisoArchivados: The speech uses the archived fields {campos}. Sheets loaded after they were archived no longer bring them, and the products that need them are left out. To avoid this, reactivate them in Uploads › Additional fields or remove them from the speech.
mowaMes.speech.v2.avisoArchivado: The speech uses the archived field {campos}. Sheets loaded after it was archived no longer bring it: in the campaign, the products that need it are left out. To avoid this, reactivate it in Uploads › Additional fields or remove it from the speech.
mowaMes.speech.v2.avisoArchivados: The speech uses the archived fields {campos}. Sheets loaded after they were archived no longer bring them: in the campaign, the products that need them are left out. To avoid this, reactivate them in Uploads › Additional fields or remove them from the speech.
mowaMes.campana.resumen.sinProblemas: No errors or warnings: the campaign can be created.
mowaMes.campana.archivoPrevisto.nota: Estimate by rows only: the real byte size can split a file further.
mowaMes.campana.limite.excedido: The campaign would exceed the monthly limit: {cargados} of {limite}. Creating it requires confirmation.

textoEnriquecido.codigo.expresion_invali: The text does not have a valid shape. Remove the marked piece and build it again.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.definicion_inval: The column is badly built. Check the content for each segment and the segmentation criterion.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.sintaxis_invalid: This saved text cannot be read. Rebuild the marked part with the pieces.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.referencia_vacia: A variable has no name. Pick one from the list or remove the piece.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.variable_descono: This variable does not exist in this context. Pick another one from the list.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.funcion_desconoc: This function does not exist. Remove it and pick one from the menu.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.parametro_invali: A function value is not valid. Check the marked field: it must be the requested type and within range.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.tipo_incompatibl: This function does not accept the type of data it receives at this point. Move it, remove the previous function or pick another one.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.limite_excedido: The text is too large. Shorten it or split it into smaller parts.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.no_se_puede_escr: This part can only be edited with the editor pieces.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.sin_segmento: The product falls in no segment and is left out of the load. Check its days past due or choose to use the default content.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.variable_obligat: A value marked as required is missing in this product.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.argumento_vacio: The function uses another variable that is empty in this product. Fill in the value or add “Value if empty”.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.division_por_cer: A division by zero was attempted with this product. Check the value being divided by.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.no_es_numero: This value is not a number. Check the data or remove the conversion.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.no_es_fecha: This value is not a date in the given format. Check the data or the format used to read it.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.telefono_invalid: The phone number is not valid: it must have 9 digits and start with 9.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.resultado_fuera_: The result is too large or falls outside the calendar. Check the values in the operation.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.valor_no_convert: The result cannot be converted to the column type. Change the type or the content.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.sin_cota_variabl: The maximum length cannot be calculated: the length of this variable depends on the data. Limit it with “First characters”.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.sin_cota_funcion: The maximum length cannot be calculated: this function does not bound it. Add “First characters” afterwards to set a cap.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.contexto_descono: That context does not exist. Reload the page.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.producto_no_enco: There is no product with that promissory note number on the cut-off date. Check the number.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.sin_version_vige: There is no current portfolio for that cut-off date. Pick another date.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.definicion_no_en: That definition does not exist. Go back to the list of definitions.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.version_no_encon: That definition does not have that version. Pick another one from the list.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.nombre_repetido: A definition with that name already exists. Pick another one.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.seleccion_no_enc: That saved selection no longer exists. Pick another one or set up the filters.
textoEnriquecido.codigo.fecha_envio_ante: The send date ({fecha_envio}) is before the cut-off date ({fecha_corte}). Choose the same date or a later one.
textoEnriquecido.variable.dias_atraso_aj: Days past due adjusted to the send date
textoEnriquecido.funcion.primeros.descri: Keeps only the first N characters. JUAN PEREZ with 8 → JUAN PER.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.ultimos.descrip: Keeps only the last N characters. 000123456 with 4 → 3456.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.mayusculas.desc: Turns the text into uppercase. ana ruiz → ANA RUIZ.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.minusculas.desc: Turns the text into lowercase. ANA RUIZ → ana ruiz.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.capitalizar.des: Makes the first letter uppercase and the rest lowercase. ANA RUIZ → Ana ruiz.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.recortar.descri: Removes spaces at both ends and merges repeated ones. “  ana   ruiz  ” → “ana ruiz”.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.sin_tildes.desc: Removes accents, diaereses and the tilde of ñ. Peña Núñez → Pena Nunez.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.a_gsm7.descripc: Keeps only the characters an SMS accepts (GSM-7): removes accents, replaces quotes, dashes and ellipses with a simple one, and deletes what has no equivalent, such as an emoji. Fee N° 5… → Fee No 5...
textoEnriquecido.funcion.reemplazar.desc: Swaps one text for another, literally and without patterns. ana-ruiz replacing “-” with a space → ana ruiz.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.rellenar_izquie: Adds a character on the left until the requested length. 1234567 with length 8 and padding 0 → 01234567.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.sumar.descripci: Adds a fixed number or the value of another variable. 100 + 5 → 105.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.restar.descripc: Subtracts a fixed number or the value of another variable. 100 − 5 → 95.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.multiplicar.des: Multiplies by a fixed number or the value of another variable. 100 × 2 → 200.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.dividir.descrip: Divides by a fixed number or the value of another variable. 100 ÷ 4 → 25. Dividing by zero is reported on the product.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.redondear.descr: Rounds to N decimals, half up. 2.345 with 2 → 2.35.
Writes the number with fixed decimals and a thousands separator. 1234567.5 → 1,234,567.50.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.a_numero.descri: Turns a text such as 150.50 into a number, so you can calculate with it.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.a_texto.descrip: Turns a number or a date into text, as it is stored, so text functions can be applied to it. 1234.5 → 1234.5.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.formato_fecha.d: Writes the date in the chosen format. 2026-10-05 with dd/mm/aaaa → 05/10/2026.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.a_fecha.descrip: Reads a text such as 05/10/2026 and turns it into a date, using the format it is written in.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.si_vacio.descri: Puts another value when the data is missing. Empty phone with “no phone” → no phone.
textoEnriquecido.funcion.enlace_whatsapp: Builds the WhatsApp link from a valid phone number. 900000123 → https://wa.me/+51900000123.
editorTexto.directa.hint: Keeps the original value, without turning it into text.
editorTexto.panel.obligatoriaHint: If this value is missing, the product is reported with its reason.
editorTexto.funcion.ninguna: There are no functions for the type of value that arrives here.
editorTexto.patron.marcas: Insert a part of the date
editorTexto.resumen.uno: There is 1 problem in the text.
editorTexto.resumen.varios: There are {n} problems in the text.
editorTexto.sinCatalogo: The variable catalogue could not be loaded. Reload the screen.
editorTexto.sinConexion: The text could not be checked. It is tried again when you edit it.
variantes.hint.porDefecto: Editing it gives this segment its own content.
columnas.title: Load columns
columnas.intro: Define which columns each load file carries and how each one is filled. Every save creates a new version; earlier ones do not change.
columnas.definicion.title: Definition
columnas.definicion.nombre.hint: The name is changed with Rename and does not create a version.
columnas.definicion.nombre.nuevo: It is unique among definitions and ignores case and accents.
columnas.proteger.hint: Adds an apostrophe to texts that start with =, +, - or @, except those that are just a number, such as -1,234.56 or +51900000001. Clear it only if the target platform does not accept it.
columnas.columnas.title: Columns
columnas.vacio.title: No saved definitions yet
columnas.vacio.cuerpo: Build the first one: type a name, add the columns and save it.
columnas.sinColumnas: This definition has no columns. Add the first one.
columnas.guardar.hint: Saving creates version {nueva}; version {actual} does not change.
columnas.guardar.hintBase: Version {nueva} will be created with this content.
columnas.problemas.resumen.uno: There is one problem that prevents saving
columnas.problemas.resumen.otros: There are {n} problems that prevent saving
columnas.error.nombreRepetido: A definition with that name already exists.
columnas.error.noExiste: The definition no longer exists. The list was reloaded.
columnas.lectura.titulo: You are viewing version {vista}. The current one is {vigente}.
columnas.base.aviso: You start from version {base}. Saving creates version {nueva} with this content and makes it the current one; version {vigente} does not change.
columnas.cambios.cuerpo: If you continue, the changes to this definition are lost.
columnas.quitar.cuerpo: The column “{nombre}” has content. It is removed from the definition when you save.
columnas.modo.perder.cuerpo: A direct variable carries no text: it keeps the first variable of each content.
columnas.variar.hint: Each segment can carry its own content; the column's content is the one the others use.
columnas.variar.sinSegmentacion: Turn on the definition's segmentation to vary the content by segment.
columnas.variar.quitar.cuerpo: The column stops varying by segment and the content of its segments is lost.
columnas.segmentacion.title: Segmentation
columnas.segmentacion.hint: Lets each column carry different content depending on the product's segment.
columnas.segmentacion.calculado: Financial segment calculated from days of delay
columnas.segmentacion.politica.excluir: Exclude the product and report the reason
columnas.segmentacion.cambiar.cuerpo: The variants the columns already have stop matching a segment and are removed.
columnas.previa.title: Preview
columnas.previa.vacia: Add a column with content to see how it looks.
columnas.previa.disponibles: Sample of {n} products out of {total} in the selection.
columnas.previa.sinProductos: The selection has no products for this cut-off date.
columnas.previa.fechaFalta: Choose the cut-off date to see real products.
columnas.previa.problemas: The definition has problems; the preview shows once they are fixed.
columnas.muestra.sinSegmento: No product in the sample falls in “{segmento}”: the preview uses the first product of the selection.
columnas.renombrar.hint: Versions and the files already generated do not change.
columnas.renombrar.nombreInvalido: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
columnas.previa.envioHoy: Segments worked out with the days past due as of today, {fecha}, as if it were sent today.
columnas.version.sinAjuste: This version works out the segments with the days past due from the sheet, without adjusting them to the send date. To use the adjustment, save a new version.
mowaMes.speech.v2.convertir.hint: To customize it, convert it to v2: you get a draft with the same messages, which is not saved until you confirm it.
mowaMes.speech.v2.borrador: Draft from “{base}”, not saved. Review each segment and save it as a new version when you confirm it.
mowaMes.speech.v2.avisoSegmento: With a real product as the sample, the segment comes from its days past due adjusted to today, as if the message were sent today; in the campaign they are adjusted to its send date.
mowaMes.speech.v2.error.sinContenido: These segments have no message: {segmentos}. Write one in each before saving.
mowaMes.speech.v2.error.pendiente: The text is still being checked. Wait a moment and save again.
mowaMes.speech.v2.error.editor: Some segments have problems. Fix them before saving.
generar.title: Generate load file
generar.intro: “Cargas” is what comes in, the daily sheets; “Generar carga” is the file that goes out to a platform, built from a selection and a column definition.
generar.definicion.title: Column definition
generar.definicion.segmentacion.excluir: Segmented: products with no segment are left out
generar.definicion.segmentacion.defecto: Segmented: products with no segment use the default content
generar.definicion.error: The definition could not be read.
generar.vacio.title: There are no saved definitions yet
generar.vacio.cuerpo: Build the first one in Load columns to be able to generate files.
generar.archivo.title: File

generar.cantidad.error: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.

generar.linea.hasta: Up to {n} rows will be generated in {formato} with version {version} of “{nombre}”, to be sent on {fecha}; products with no segment are left out.

camposAdicionales.gestion.intro: The fields you created when uploading sheets. Archiving one takes it off the lists and out of the next sheets; what is already loaded is not deleted.
camposAdicionales.gestion.vacio: There are no additional fields yet. They are created when you upload a sheet, from the column review.
camposAdicionales.gestion.caption: Additional fields of the catalogue
camposAdicionales.gestion.nombreHint: Whatever already uses it keeps working: it is saved under its internal name, which does not change.
camposAdicionales.gestion.nombreRepetido: There is already a field called “{campo}”. Use another name.
camposAdicionales.gestion.nombreArchivad: There is already an archived field called “{campo}”. Reactivate it or use another name.
camposAdicionales.gestion.archivado: “{campo}” was archived. It is no longer offered, and the sheets you upload from now on will not bring it.
camposAdicionales.gestion.errorCarga: The additional fields could not be loaded.
camposAdicionales.avisoArchivado: It uses the archived field {campo}. Sheets loaded after it was archived no longer bring it: there it is empty. To avoid this, reactivate it in Uploads › Additional fields.
camposAdicionales.avisoArchivados: It uses the archived fields {campo}. Sheets loaded after they were archived no longer bring them: there they are empty. To avoid this, reactivate them in Uploads › Additional fields.
